blocks.orig: Serengeti Pioneer Camp is a wondrous tented camp in the heart of the Serengeti National Park, where it offers beautifully appointed tented rooms. The ensuite tents are set in the middle of the wilderness, where they offer all the amenities you could wish for whilst capturing the original essence of the mobile African safari. While dining under the endless star-filled skies of the Serengeti plains, you enjoy delicious, gastronomic cuisine. To top it off, the Serengeti Pioneer Camp offers sweeping views over Moru Kopjes, Lake Magadi, and of course, the endless Serengeti plains where the animals are not too shy to pay the occasional visit to the camp.
